prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium photorealistic 3D CAD-style studio render for a Thai engineering presentation. A SINGLE moving glass door panel retracting to the right behind a stationary glass panel, stainless-steel portal frame, overhead linear track with visible realistic black timing belt and two pulleys, small geared motor mounted above. Isometric front three-quarter view, complete assembly visible, no cropping. Two thin cyan horizontal safety sensing beams across the open LEFT passage at low and medium heights, sensors on fixed jambs just in front of the sliding plane. No people. Subtle glass reflections and brushed metal, soft studio shadows, pure white background. Landscape image, isolated product centrally filling canvas, restrained blue and slate palette. No labels, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. This is a conceptual 3D illustration, not proof of a built product.

Use case: scientific-educational. One cohesive three-panel engineering storyboard, wide horizontal image, three equal panels separated ONLY by generous white whitespace, no borders and NO text or symbols. Same realistic single-panel stainless and glass sliding doorway viewed front three-quarter in each panel. Small low wheeled suitcase with handle fully down travels across the threshold, NO humans or animals. Panel 1: doorway open, suitcase entering left passage beneath a single HIGH sensing beam, demonstrating a blind area. Panel 2: conventional glass panel sliding left toward the suitcase with a narrow hazardous gap, subtle red translucent pinch-zone glow, suitcase undamaged, no injury. Panel 3: doorway fully reopened to the right, the low suitcase breaks the LOWER of TWO cyan through-beams between fixed jambs. Refined photorealistic CAD studio render throughout, realistic rail, belt and small gearmotor above, accurate consistent mechanical construction, pale gray floor, pure white background. No arrows, icons, text, digits or badges, these will be added as editable slide annotations. Entire objects uncropped.

Use case: product-mockup. Photorealistic strict top-down orthographic macro studio render of ATMEL AT89S52 24PU microcontroller, DIP-40 package. Exactly TWENTY distinct equally spaced silver pins along the LEFT long side, and exactly TWENTY along the RIGHT long side, total 40 pins. No pins at short ends. Very long narrow rectangular matte black epoxy body, semi-circular notch at TOP short edge, small pin-one dot near top left. White laser marking 'ATMEL' and 'AT89S52' and '24PU'. Perfectly straight vertical orientation with no perspective foreshortening. Whole part visible, pure white background with very soft shadow, no diagram or wiring, ultra-sharp pins and body, catalog quality. Do not invent internal circuit graphics. Accuracy of all forty pins is essential.

Use case: product-mockup. Photorealistic studio catalog 3D render of industrial mushroom head emergency stop pushbutton. Red mushroom cap with two simple white reset arrows, yellow collar, realistic dark mounting/contact assembly below and TWO exposed screw-terminal pairs for dual normally-closed contacts. Front three-quarter isometric view from slightly above. Entire assembly visible and isolated on pure white background, subtle soft gray shadow, restrained lighting and realistic metal/plastic, no caption, no brand, no watermark. Match premium industrial CAD product presentation.
